summary: Backend-only test pass for SEC-001 media auth patch, unified broker order-event watchdog (Public + MooMoo), and LULD RoadGuard. Ran all requested pytest suites plus new live integration tests against the public backend URL. 133/133 tests green.
critical_code_review_comments: media.py upload_chunk / upload: FastAPI resolves the UploadFile dependency BEFORE the handler runs, so missing `file` on POST /api/media/upload-chunk returns 422 without invoking _require_admin. Not a security leak (no file is processed), but the 422-vs-401 discrepancy could reveal that the field is required to an unauthenticated caller. Consider wrapping auth as a router dependency (Depends(require_admin)) so it runs before body parsing.

POST /api/media/upload response returns file_id but no uploaded_by field — clients that want to confirm attribution must round-trip GET /api/media. Consider echoing uploaded_by in the upload response for observability.
